about: Which screens a sales manager may open, by the team they manage. Both apps read this file in their tests: the dashboard's sidebar and routes (client/src/domain/sales.ts) and the phone's manager workspace (app/lib/core/manager_scope.dart). Pareeth's team raises the orders, so that manager gets the order pipeline; the others work party records and their own people. An unrecognised team gets the reduced set, never the full one.

cases.why: Pareeth's team raises the orders, so the whole pipeline is theirs.
Saneesh works party records and their own people, nothing else.
Renjith likewise, despite also being the production manager.
A team nobody configured must not silently inherit the order pipeline. The failure that costs least is the one where somebody asks for access.
The token is a stored value, not free text: a different casing is not Pareeth.
Surrounding spaces are trimmed before matching.
Somebody who manages no team gets nothing at all.
Blank is the same as no team.
The GM's work is the escalation queue; no team screen is theirs, whatever token they carry.
